notes.title: NEW game update, features & bugfixes! (4.1e)
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Long time no see!

We have been doing some changes to the game, we added some features and also fixed some annoying bugs. Here are the details:


[h1]+ Fixed FPS Drop & Lag problem![/h1] (Now gone forever! XD)

[h1]+NEW controller support added![/h1] (No rebinding for now, select it on Game Launcher).

+ Updated Game Launcher:
  - NEW Options: Controller or Joystick selection!
  - NEW Options: Screenshot shortcut!

+ Fixed minor errors & bugs.
+ Cleaned and updated Code.

+ Updated Game Options:
  - Windows color
  - BGM, BGS, EFX Volumen
  - Resolution
  - Aspect Ratio
  - Window Style

+ NEW Video Player.

+ Corrected some typos and mispellings.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Some pictures:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24335968/e2016f766e290755d1ae1d18dd13754e44ade929.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24335968/1e63c56a31b8d2994a2be03c8e2da0d5a5a1c6fc.png[/img]

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
www.emptysoul.clorithstudio.com
www.facebook.com/emptysoulindie

Thanks everyone for the love & support!
~ EmptyTeam

notes.title: RELEASE DATE!
notes.content:
Hello, dear souls! ːsolanwallsː

[h1] We are happy to announce that Empty Soul will be released on June 30![/h1] 

The game will include several features and improvements, like:
- Graphic improvements
- Soundtrack
- Official artbook 
- Fanbook
- Steam achievements
- Trading cards
- Cloud save

And an extra chapter that will be released soon, and will help to complement the main story...

Thanks everyone for the support!  ːsolanː
